name: Cafe-Restaurant Pizzeria Urgner Stube
kurzbeschreibung: Café-Restaurant Pizzeria Urgner Stube in Fließ Welcome to Café-Restaurant Pizzeria Urgner Stube, a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of Fließ, where traditional Tyrolean charm…
beschreibung: The Cafe-Restaurant Pizzeria Urgner Stube in Fließ in the Landeck region stands for elevated Tyrolean hospitality with Italian culinary flair. The kitchen pairs alpine favorites like dumplings and beef dishes with stone-baked pizzas and fresh pastas. Utilizing prime regional ingredients, the warm wooden dining rooms and attentive staff provide a comfortable environment for family gatherings or romantic dinners in western Tirol.
